costume.name: Autumn Scarecrow
costume.description: An ochre plaid shirt and patched denim overalls, topped with a soft rust hat and cloth straw details.
costume.alt: Rust patchwork hat, ochre plaid shirt, patched denim overalls, straw-colored fabric tufts, and brown boots

pieces.name: Rust or brown pointed scarecrow hat
pieces.styleNotes: A floppy pointed hat anchors the scarecrow. Choose warm rust or brown; none reproduces every patch, rope and sunflower in the generated image. The separate patch fabric can personalize an undecorated hat. Rust hat alternatives differ in shape and decoration. The premium hat has no published sizing; confirm fit before purchase.

matches.reason: Faux suede hat includes tall peak, jagged brim, patches, rope band and attached small black crow. About 25-inch circumference; fits most teens and adults per merchant. Brown rather than the image's orange rust; crow replaces its sunflower. Live feed confirms available at $19.99.

Merchant calls the hat straw; its fiber is not specified. Live feed confirms the single variant available at $14.99. Ships Monday–Friday from Chicago; no arrival promise.
